title.zh-Hans: 重生之我在温肯当校长

description.zh-Hans: 一款像素风校园经营模拟游戏。你将出任温州肯恩大学校长，在五年任期中平衡资金、招生、声誉、科研、满意度与健康，建设 13 个校园项目，处理每月决策，并解锁校园影像与多种结局。
description.en: A pixel-art campus management simulation. Serve as president of Wenzhou-Kean University, balance six institutional metrics across a five-year term, build 13 campus projects, make monthly decisions, and unlock campus photography and multiple endings.

entrypoints.name: 重生之我在温肯当校长
